allResults.rationale: Emissions from diesel fuel combusted in the reporting company's own fleet are direct greenhouse gas emissions.
Refrigerant HFC-32 top-up for plant HVAC represents fugitive emissions, which are direct emissions from equipment owned or controlled by the reporting company.
Purchased electricity from the grid for factory operations falls under Scope 2 indirect emissions.
District heat purchased and consumed for office campus operations falls under Scope 2 indirect emissions from acquired energy.
Purchased raw materials such as aluminium sheets are upstream emissions associated with the production of goods bought by the reporting company.
Emissions from upstream air freight of electronic components operated by a third-party logistics provider fall under Scope 3, Category 4 (Upstream Transportation and Distribution).
Purchased grid electricity consumption falls under Scope 2 emissions.
Ocean freight provided by a third-party logistics supplier falls under Scope 3, specifically upstream transportation and distribution.
Road freight of machine parts provided by a third-party logistics service falls under upstream transportation and distribution.
Landfill disposal of waste generated in operations is an indirect greenhouse gas emission that falls under Scope 3, specifically under Category 5 (Waste generated in operations).
Purchased raw materials such as aluminium sheets are upstream value chain activities and fall under Scope 3.
Emissions from upstream or downstream transportation and distribution of goods in vehicles not owned or controlled by the reporting company fall under Scope 3.
Upstream transportation and distribution of goods purchased by the reporting company, operated by a third-party logistics provider (MSC Line).
Road freight of machine parts provided by a third-party logistics supplier falls under upstream transportation and distribution in Scope 3.
Purchased finished goods (cotton t-shirts) from a supplier fall under Scope 3, specifically Category 1 (Purchased Goods and Services).
Disposal of waste generated in operations is classified as a Scope 3 indirect emission source.
The procurement of a CNC machining centre classified as capital equipment falls under Scope 3, Category 2 (Capital Goods) of the GHG Protocol.

Well-to-tank upstream emissions associated with the extraction, production, and transportation of diesel fuel purchased for the fleet fall under Scope 3, Category 3 (Fuel- and Energy-Related Activities Not Included in Scope 1 or Scope 2).
Ocean freight of goods operated by a third-party logistics provider (COSCO) falls under Scope 3, specifically upstream or downstream transportation and distribution.
Landfill disposal of waste generated in operations falls under Scope 3, specifically under Category 5 (Waste generated in operations).
Business travel by employees on commercial flights falls under Scope 3, Category 6 (Business Travel).

Employee commuting falls under Scope 3, specifically Category 7 (Employee Commuting), as it involves transportation of employees for commuting between their homes and their worksites in vehicles not owned or operated by the reporting company.
